long_biography.plain_text:
Buying Château de la Messardière was supposed to be Gilles Gibier's pre-retirement project. Instead, the Saint-Tropez property became a two-decade operating chapter: he participated in hotel management while the ownership interest was consolidated inside Worldwide Smart Destinations Development. A 2019 transfer to LOV Group allowed him to step back from hospitality, leaving the Luxembourg vehicle as the clearest public expression of his investment role.

The capital behind that move was rooted in engineering. An Arts et Métiers graduate, Gibier first created a heat-treatment business and sold it once profitable, moved into turnround consulting, and joined Schlumberger to reorganise electricity-meter production. His technology career reached Axiohm, where securities documents place him among the transaction-printer company's named beneficial owners and record a board co-chairmanship alongside strategic oversight of its French operations.
